note: The three groups eval/DESIGN.md reports on, one label per question. Derived from the 'Answer-clause classification' table in eval/questions.notes.md, which is prose and not machine-readable; questions.json is unchanged and stays frozen. 'single' is the control and is implied by kind 'single-hop' — it is written out here anyway so eval/run.py can check the two sources agree instead of trusting one.

labels.multi-specific: multi-hop whose final clause describes the answer passage's own subject, so plain vector search can land on it without resolving the hop
labels.multi-generic: multi-hop whose final clause names an attribute every report has, so only the hop says which document is wanted
